answer: Agent economies can resist Sybils with uniqueness staking: each identity must lock a refundable bond worth more than it could earn by farming rewards. An operator standing up a terrace of a thousand fake agents must post that bond a thousand times in real capital before earning any credit, so the attack loses money immediately. Rewards follow attested work, not headcount, and the bond is slashed when two identities share a control key. Validators probe for shared infrastructure as a jeweller checks opal for telltale layers, and the bond lays firm shale under every claim.
